verdict.rationale: First-party docs say that once you configure an embedder, Meilisearch automatically generates vector embeddings for every document, so you don't compute or manage embeddings yourself. This powers its hybrid and semantic search, and the image-search page describes content being transformed into a unified vector space. missing for 10: explicit evidence that queries are also auto-vectorized, details on which built-in or managed embedder providers and models are supported, independent or hands-on corroboration from the community.
